item.title: Bulletin updated at 09:45 HKT 28/Dec/2021
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An intense winter monsoon will continue to bring cold weather to southern China today. With weather improving over the coast of southern China, temperatures will rise slightly during the day over the region in the middle and latter parts of this week, but it will remain cool in the morning and at night. Under the influence of an easterly airstream, the weather is expected to be cloudier with one or two rain patches over the coast of Guangdong early next week.
